findings.issue: No test script, runner, or devDependency anywhere in the app; all behaviour is guarded only by the external acceptance suite
findings.suggestion: Add at least a lightweight unit runner (vitest works well with Astro) covering the pure helpers in src/lib/pokeapi.ts and the pagination/filtering logic extracted from index.astro

findings.issue: Filter matching, page parsing/clamping (48-per-page slice) and 'Page n of total' are untested; off-by-one or humanized-vs-API-name search regressions would slip through
findings.suggestion: Extract filtering/pagination into a pure function in src/lib and unit-test it against humanized names (mr-mime), slot-matching types and boundary pages

findings.issue: The moves pipeline (default game = highest order, method priority order, level-up sort by level then name) is dense inline logic with no tests
findings.suggestion: Extract the version-group/method grouping and ordering into a tested module; pin down the (a.order ?? 0) fallback and unknown-method alphabetical fallback

findings.issue: Client-side sortable table depends on data-* attribute names and dataset[key] access; missing-values-last and aria-sort flipping are only guarded by one E2E pass
findings.suggestion: Extract the compare() function to a module and unit-test missing-last in both directions and ascending/descending toggling

findings.issue: Client filter script never listens to popstate: after pushState, the back button changes the URL but leaves stale results in the DOM; also the requestId race-guard is untested
findings.suggestion: Handle popstate (re-fetch or reload for the restored URL) and add a test that drives search, then back, and asserts the results match the restored URL

findings.issue: getHomeIndex assembles species/types/generation from three API scans (slot ordering, id>10000 exclusion, missing-type species get empty arrays); regressions here corrupt every list page
findings.suggestion: Unit-test against small fixture payloads, including a species absent from every type detail and one whose slots arrive out of order

findings.issue: Promise cache with rejection eviction is untested; a bug that caches a rejected promise (or never evicts on failure) would make every page 500 until restart
findings.suggestion: Test that a failing fetch is not cached and a subsequent call retries, and that 404 maps to NotFoundError while other statuses throw

findings.issue: Hidden-ability merge (bySpecies map OR-ing is_hidden across forms) is subtle and untested; ordering a non-hidden entry after a hidden one loses the flag
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the merge with a species that appears twice (default + hidden form) in different orders

findings.issue: latestEnglishFlavorText ('last en entry, whitespace collapsed') would pass naive refactors: flipping to first-entry or dropping the \f collapse is easy and only partially covered by acceptance tests
findings.suggestion: Direct unit tests for entry ordering, whitespace collapse and empty-input cases

findings.issue: formatHeight/formatWeight/formatMissing (em dash, one decimal place) are trivial but spec-pinned formatters with no tests
findings.suggestion: One-line table-driven tests would pin the '—' and rounding behaviour

summary: The app ships no tests of any kind — no runner, no script, nothing — so every score for coverage and regression power is floored. All the riskiest logic (filtering/pagination, the moves pipeline, the client sorter, URL-state handling) sits untested in pages and inline scripts where refactors would fail silently. The acceptance suite covers outcomes broadly, but once the data layer changes shape, the absence of any app-owned guard will let subtle bugs (page clamping, default-game selection, cache eviction, back-button state) through.
